nom: Klairs Gentle Black Deep Cleansing Oil

avis.texte: This made my skin super unhappy, breakouts with red patches all over. Took my face makeup off but failed to get waterproof mascara off. Sensitive skin ppl just skip this one

I try to use clean, cruelty free products that are also safe for sensitive skin. While this product hasnt triggered any new breakouts, it's weird and hard to use. Super slippery, but doesnf pull or remove much and leaves a serious residue. I have to rinse my face 3x with one pump used, followed by my water based cleanser. Will not repurchase.
I will repurchase this over and over again! I use it as my first step cleanser to remove makeup. Cleansing oils aren't meant to be used alone so make sure to follow up with a second step cleanser.

Personally didn't work for me. It's very runny and feels too lightweight that it just kind slips around on your skin without doing much. It doesn't clear out sebaceous filaments or pore gunk like other oil cleansers i have tried. It does a decent job removing foundation and sunscreen but it performs poorly with eye makeup like waterproof eyeliner and mascara. I ALWAYS end up with panda eyes and yes I do emulsify it before washing off. Definitely would not purchase again since it does neither of the things I neither of the things that I need it to do. You can get much better for the price honestly.

Omg if you have dry sensitive skin buy this now it didnt irritate my skin or even make it red which is a mircle and my skin looks so soft blackheads where shes gone the only thing i would recommend using warm water when rinsing it is a little hard to wash off but worth it

avis.titre: Wonderful cleansing oil for dry skin
avis.texte: I've been using this for over a year and I love it. Takes off the most resistant makeup and sunscreen without leaving my skin stripped. I do double cleanse and use a creamy gentle cleanser afterwards. My skin type is dry leans dehydrated. Not prone to acne but I do have occasional clogged pores.
I have dry sensitive skin. This product is my favorite. Hydrates and melts off my full coverage foundation and sunscreen. I'm on my 2nd bottle.

This has to be the worst cleansing oil i've ever owned. I bought this when my go-to cleansing oil was out of stock & just… no. This oil just slips around & doesnt break down any makeup. When you try to wash it off it doesnt move and leaves thee worst greasy film. By the time I went to dry my face my towels were covered with oil & leftover makeup that this did literally nothing to remove. Thank gooodness my go-to came back in stock soon after because yikes..
I've been struggling with slacking skin because of retionol. I swapped this product out from my prior cleanser. it's helped a ton. Love this product. Will repurchase
Nice and gentle. I was initially scared off the by the "oil" part but it didn't make my skin feel greasy at all.
Very gentle but efficient cleansing oil. Good for my dry skin

It worked so well to take off makeup! You definitely need to use on dry skin, then wash off, its just a little less effective on wet skin. But you will need to double cleanse too. Overall felt great, not irration, and clean off all my makeup!
This removes my makeup nicely. Quite easy to rinse, and I top it off with a foam cleanser. It's quite runny (think it's because of the formula as well) but it's not as thick as when I use pure oil.
I have sensitive skin eczema and dry skin. This product helps hydrate my skin during cold winters or in the triple didget summers in Texas.
This is one of the worst cleansing oils i have tried, it doesn't emulsify very well and doesnt wash off makeup good either, its hard to remove from your face so i don't recommend it!

I was interested in oil cleansing and didn't know where to start. Skipping the chemistry lesson has made my face angry; I haven't had pimples and breakouts like this since my teens. First, I have combination leaning-oily skin prone to clogged pores, breakouts, and acne, which means I really needed something lower/noncomedogenic. This contains soybean and sesame oil, which don't always play nice with clogging pores. Application was very runny, but definitely felt effective at clearing sebaceous filaments. It didn't emulsify very well (tried a few different ways) and after rinsing for several min, I still felt oil. Didn't see a difference in breakouts with a double-cleanse. It smells nice? A very light, sweet scent.

I don't understand at all why anyone likes this cleansing oil….. I love dear klair's but this product leaves behind the worst sticky white film that's so hard to remove. When I get a oil cleanser I want to be able to have it rinse off clean with absolutely no film or weird texture when I use this stuff. I literally have to find an exfoliating brush to get the remainder of it off. Even my second cleanse doesn't get the film off it's so gross. I love earth, Harbor sunshine dew and biossance pre cleansing oil. Those two are nice and thin and they take my sunscreen, (which is the Isdin sunscreen and is extremely hard to get off) right off with no problem. There's no film left behind and I wouldn't even have to use the second cleanse if I was in a hurry
I wish I could give it more stars!!! I think its do amazing & effective! It cleans so well
I wish I could give it more stars!!! I think its do amazing & effective! It cleans so well
I really enjoy using this product as a first cleanse to remove makeup. Good value, works well, would repurchase.

I've used many oil cleansers but strayed from my go to since it was out of stock. I've used other Klairs products and they are my holy grails so I had really high hopes for this oil cleanser… After the first use I started breaking out like CRAZY! This has never happened with others and I double cleanse every time. I thought it was a fluke and so I stopped using it and went back to my old oil cleanser but again ran out. I had this one left over and after using it woke up the next morning with so many pimples. Never purchasing again and it's a shame because I have a full bottle of it.
Great overall product if your someone who has sensitive skin! Definitely a great double cleanser to help remove water proof makeup.

If you aren't using this as part of a double cleanse routine, it's going to leave an oily residue… that said, it is great for the first step in a double cleanse. It effectively breaks up make-up, sunscreen/products and it feels nice to rub around my face. I like how it gets slightly milky when I wet my face after loosening all the gunk. I follow with a foaming cleanser and it is easy to remove that way. The smell is very natural and faint. The only reason i took a star is because it is very runny so it can get messy if you aren't careful and I have found that the bottle pump does leak a little. But this is a great product at worth the price.
I like the consistency, but I do find it doesn't emulsify well and leaves a residue

I am a big Klair's girlie. I use the Vitamin E mask and Calendula cleanser but this oil was not what I expected. It became really hard to wash off and I ended up having to use literal hand soap to wash it off my hands altogether. Other oil cleansers will emulsify and melt off easily. I probably won't finish the bottle and will not order again.

This is the first cleansing oil I tried (I'm a balm gal) and I really enjoyed it! There is little to no scent and it didn't leave my eyes blurry. It felt nice on the skin and washed off easily in my opinion. I would recommend this to a friend!

avis.titre: One of my all time faves
avis.texte: This was gone for a while and I was so sad I couldn't find it in stock. This has always been one of my favorite oil cleansers of all time! It's light weight, removes all make up and doesn't strip or dry my skin at all. The scent is minimal or even barely detectable.

avis.titre: one of the worse cleansing oils I've tried.
avis.texte: as the title says, I didn't really think it was easy to mess up a cleansing balm and oil, but this is one I've tried where it's just a no. it feels like it just sits on your skin and repels water when you try to rinse, so you end up having to use a washcloth to wipe it all off.

I use Tretinoin. Going on my 2nd year, once a week. I use this every night after using micellar water. It's always been gentle on my skin. Picks up any oil, dirt, make up, and I find this perfect to help remove the dry, scaly, dead skin that occurs during those few days after Tretinoin night. It help to ball them as I massage carefully. After a 2nd foam wash, my skin can definitely breath and be smooth again. Maybe there are other products that help do this. However, this is the only oil cleanser I've used since I've started using Tretinoin. It's been wonderful for me, so I have no need to experience another brand.

I loved the fresh cleaning oil version and was excited to try this. But, this turned out to be a waste. I love using oil as first cleanse and this one is sticky, does not emulsify well and doesn't wash off easy. You have to use a good cleanser to get this off. I will be going back to the fresh version which does what it's suppose to, melt off makeup and wash off.

I used Clinique's Take The Day Off cleansing balm for years until I discovered this product. It performs similarly to Clinique but leaves my skin soft and smooth without feeling stripped. It also doesn't leave my eyes as blurry as I've experienced with other cleansing balms.
I love this cleanser. It does a great job at removing makeup, even that stubborn eye makeup without drying out my face.

I've been using this cleanser as part of my nighttime skincare routine for a little over a year now and just ... wow. It's amazing, totally cleans out my pores, makes my skin feel so hydrated and soft. I wish I could give it 10 stars, not just 5.
Love it so much, perfect for dry skin. I had a big problem with finding a cleanser which doesn't dry out my skin. But I really need a alter based cleanser which u can use afterwards.

avis.titre: Does what it is supposed to
avis.texte: This works great at removing makeup, it is gentle and smooth. I used this as a double cleanse. I recommend double cleaning when using an oil cleanser, otherwise the oil will stay on your skin and you may risk clogging your pores.

I love oil cleansers. I've been using Clean it zero because my skin is sensitive and it's hard to find a good oil cleanser. I didn't know I'd find a better cleanser! Klairs' oil cleanser comes with a pump which is great for my sensitive skin! Tip: Combine with the acid gel cleanser by wishtrend and your skin will feel smooth and clean!

avis.titre: Good cleanser but runs out quickly
avis.texte: Don't listen to the other reviewers saying that it didn't work. It does work if you actually read the directions. Use dry hands on a dry face and rub the oil into the skin first. Then when you feel like you've the gunk out or your makeup has blended into the oil, then you go in with water and it will turn into a sort of milky liquid which actually does wash off well with water. Make sure you use enough water. It's not going to take only one splash of water to the face and wash off, people. No oil cleanser or other water based cleanser will do that for you. I think a lot of people don't bother to read directions and blame the product when they didn't care to research it or read the directions. A lot of oil cleansers will require to not mix with water, and some others will require water to mix in first (this product follows the former). Do not use cotton pads or cloth to take this off with the oil. It will not work that way. It works well for my acne prone and combo skin but I alway follow up with another cleanser because I like to double cleanse and I wear a full face of makeup daily. It takes me at least 2-3 pumps so I run out quickly when I use this product. Be careful when using this to rub off makeup in your eye area because it will sting a bit but not too much. I use other products now because I need a bigger bottle otherwise I would stay with this one.

It has a refreshing scent, but I believe that some people might find it too heavy. This oil did a great job of getting off sunscreen or makeup, without stripping my skin moisture. Rinsed off fairly well without leaving a heavy residue. It doesn't dry out my skin and cleans my face so well. My skin looks brighter and feels softer after every use.

I use it everyday day as my first step cleanser with the dear Klairs Gentle Black Facial Cleanser. They are the perfect duo together. The cleansing oil is really gentle with my sensitive skin. It doesn't irritate or dry out my face. After using it my face feels moist. It comes off easily with water so not necessary the second step cleansing, but with the foam, the amount of my blackheads reduced drastically. Only a little bit of product(one pump) is enough for my whole face and neck.
I personally found it a little bit inconvenient since being an oil, it requires a good washing up after

That's the first time i ever used a Oil Cleanser in my life and i like it very much. It cleanses off all makeup, even waterproof and it has a very nice slight natural scent. i didn't get any breakouts or blackheads from it either.

Although I barely wear any make-up, I do use SPF. Before, I only used a foam cleanser, but I thought it might not be enough to wash away SPF. After seeing several recommendations for double cleansing and the benefits of cleansing oil, I decided to try this product. I like the scent of this product, and I use it as the first step of my nighttime routine. When my skin warms up and melts the cleansing oil, I use gua sha to massage and relax my facial muscles. The overall experience is very pleasant, and the oil washes off quickly.
I really love them for a first cleanse to remove make up. Hydrating and efficient.

avis.titre: Wanted to love it, but it's kind of bad
avis.texte: I love Klairs, and I love cleansing oils and balms. I bought this when my other cleansing oil was about half finished so I didn't need it for months actually (why do I do this) and only just tried it yesterday. I knew from the very first use that I had messed up. This is a lesson to me not to buy new products unless I'm going to use them within the return period, or at least test them out. Rather than emulsifying and turning milky when I add water this almost gets thicker on my face and it takes a wash cloth and a double-cleanse to get it off. I try not to waste stuff but the idea of being stuck with this cleanser until it's finished is a little depressing. I might try to see if someone else wants it and just go back to my original oil cleanser. Hanskin oil cleanser never did me wrong like this, lol. I still love the Klairs supple toner to pieces, fragranced version even, but this one was a dud for me. I have to go wash my face in a bit and honestly, I think I'll use the ponds cold cream I have on hand and a cotton round to get my work makeup off, because that oil cleanser is such a pain. Definitely not for me.

I don't wear makeup everyday but anytime I do wear makeup, I double cleanse. This cleansing oil works great as my first cleanse. It glides on easily and breaks up all my makeup and products. It creates a nice foam if I wet it after spreading on my face (not exactly a lather but a nice thickish foam). It rinses off my face pretty well but it does leave a slight oily layer. Not a problem for me as I always follow with a second cleanse, but if you have oily skin and don't double cleanse, this isn't for you. I find this brand to be excellent quality for the price. I only gave 4 stars because I do find that this product doesn't rinse as well from my neck as it does from my face so I need to take extra care to rinse my neck.

The texture feels like a normal cleansing oil but feels extremely nourishing upon application. This does not have the dry oil finish compared to other cleansing oils. - It spread well across skin and effectively removes all debris. My skin's moisture is not stripped and prepped for the next step. - The con is this is not listed as fragrance free. There are also various plant seed oils that provide the scent and possible irritation. However, on the wishtrend website mentioned this was suited for sensitive skin. - I would recommend this to people looking for a nourishing cleansing oil!

This is my favourite oil cleanser. This one feels light and leaves no oily residue. Also some of the other oil cleansers I have tried gathers around the eyes after but this fully washes off. I like the light foam it creates as you know it is fully washed off. Ive been using the same bottle for the last year, you only need one pump per use! I will buy again once it has run out

This is definitely gentle and a heavier/thicker cleansing oil. It's quite effective, but I find it needs more water and warmer water to fully emulsify and clean off. (The first time I used it and my hands were freezing cold and I ended up making it quite think and white on my face!) Using it in the shower it's excellent though! I have also mixed it with their sugar scrub and they make a great pair, once a week, leaving the skin extra soft with all that oil. Love that!

The application of this product on my face was like a baby oil! At first, I'm kinda worried that the water can't wash it off since it's an oil cleanser since it was also my first time to try that type of cleanser. But after some time of using it, removing my makeup became more easier and convenient for me. 10/10 because this product works on my skin and it is my current makeup remover since it can take off my "water-proof" mascara, lipsticks, primer and foundation. I am also happy that my skin feels bouncier and cleaner since I usually double cleanse - wherein I use my regular cleaner after using this oil from Klairs~

avis.titre: Good cleansing oil, but a double cleanse is necessary
avis.texte: So far I've used the banila co cleansing balm and the Hanskin AHA cleansing oil. I fell in love with cleansing oils after how efficiently they removed all my makeup. This cleansing oil works just as well as the other two I've tried. It removes all my makeup with little effort, smells nice, and leaves my skin supple and soft. The only downside is that you HAVE to double cleanse (aka use a foaming cleanser after the oil cleanser) to remove it. The box for this product even recommends you combine it with their black sugar scrub before washing off. I didn't do that because I am not about to damage my skin with a sugar scrub. Overall it's really good, just takes an extra product to completely remove the leftover oil.

Very good cleansing oil. Cleanses my skin properly and no breakouts caused. I double cleanse using this product as the first step. So simple and effective to use. I have never experienced bad reactions to Klairs products.

avis.titre: So amazing even for very sensitive skin
avis.texte: I've always had normal and healthy skin until I had impetigo which affected a huge part of my face, later on resulted in eczema. During my recent flare up, I could not use any of my usual cleansers, and this product really helped a great deal with my cleansing routine. It doesn't irritate at all, but surprisingly soothes my skin while cleansing it really well. Remember to emulsify the oil with lukewarm water for easier rinse off. The only minor setback for me is that it tends to clump up around the areas in between my nose and eyes. The quicker way for me to cleanse it off would be to use a gentle foaming cleanser just around the eye area. This is definitely something I will repurchase. It's so versatile, I also use it together with I'm From Fig Mask during the final scrubbing step for that extra deep cleansing. My pores are so clean! Highly recommend this.

I'm almost 50 with clear skin and I'm pretty sure this is what's been breaking me out recently. It doesn't rinse off. I use it as part of a 2 step cleanse but the second step now has to also wash this goop off. It's a disappointing product and I won't repurchase. Smells good, hence the 2 stars.

This is the first step of my routine day and night. This is so effective at cleaning my face and it feels really good. I was skeptical at first because it comes out of the bottle just as oil but it leaves my skin feeling so soft and refreshed.
Usually, cream/liquid cleansers would leave my face feeling tight, but this oil cleanser cleans deeply and gently! It's great after a summer day when my face has a build-up of products and sweat.
My favorite cleansing oil, this is my 3rd bottle. Takes off everything easily and emulsifies effortlessly. Subtle scent, never stings my skin even if it's irritated.

avis.titre: The only cleansing oil I'll use!
avis.texte: I'm not usually a fan of cleansing oils, I much prefer a balm but this oil feels super fine and luxurious on the skin. It does an amazing job at removing all of my makeup (even waterproof) and rinses without any oily residue. My skin always feel super clean and soft after using this as my first step in cleansing.
Im in olve with this cleansing oil. I used it at night only, follow up with the Green tea powder. I recommend

avis.titre: My one and only favorite oil cleanser!
avis.texte: This cleanser is a MUST-HAVE in my routine! I believe I've repurchased this 3 times so far! Some people seem to be bothered by the smell, but I absolutely adore it. This oil cleanser gets rid of even the most stubborn waterproof mascara, and it leaves my combination skin feeling so smooth and comfortable - it's light enough for my oily T-zone but nourishing enough for my dry, flaky U-zone! I would even rate this 10 stars out of 5 if I could!
I really love this cleansing oil, because after it my skin is smooth and clean without irritation! I recommend it all my friends and they were happy to use it < 3

I must say that this is my HG Oil Cleanser, it really managed to wash away my makeup after a long day of wearing it. For the lip area, it takes quite some time to remove the lip stains especially the long lasting ones. But it is definitely good enough because of the brand's mission for their products are recommended for sensitive skin. I'm happy that it really compliments my face & leaves no breakouts when using it. Hope that it would last and be my HG Oil Cleanser forever!

I've tried quite a few cleansing balms and they either break me out because they're too fragranced or they don't fully remove my waterproof mascara. Decided to switch to this and I love it for double cleansing! When you first go to wash it off it doesn't fully come off, but when you go in with your cleanser it removes everything. My face doesn't feel stripped of moisture and doesn't break me out. Def a 10/10

This was the first time I tried an oil cleanser and I thought I would hate it, but it actually felt great and became the favorite part of my skincare routine. I don't wear makeup but I do wear sunscreen everyday and it removed it well. It has a very faint nice smell and I guess it's not the lightest oil cleanser but I like the consistency.
This is the first and only oil cleanser I've tried, but if the shoe fits why try and change it? Works wonderfully every time
It does not clean well, and it leaves an oily film on your face after washing with water
My face feels so soft after I use this, and my blackheads look so much smaller too. You only need to use one pump, and it's enough. I will definitely repurchase this!
It's my first time trying a double cleanse and Klairs cleansing oil feels great on my skin - not sticky, oily or thick. So hydrating for my skin. I also love the gentle fragrance, so soothing.

avis.titre: Great as double or single cleanse
avis.texte: for a while i had no other cleanser, so i used this only and it worked great! emulsified really well and does not leave an oily residue on the skin. I now use it mostly as a spf remover in my double cleanse. I have dry skin so that's probably why it was okay as a single cleanse!

If you haven't tried oil cleansers before, you are cheating yourself. This product is gentle and deeply effective at removing blackheads, makeup, and everything else you want to cleanse off your skin. I use it as the first step in double cleansing but if your skin is very dry this might be the only cleanser you need.

I love this product for the summer time because I can put it directly on dry skin (per the directions) and get a really deep but gentle clean. I have oily /combination skin that gets tight and irritated with moist cleansers you find in US drug stores, but this stuff is FANTASTIC. You get a really effective clean without drying out the skin. I use this in conjunction with a gentle brush exfoliator or the black sugar scrub.

I only got to try 2 samples of this but boy was I impressed! I'm a girl who loves to play around with makeup and this works wonders. It does a good job of removing all my makeup and the sediments on my skin. If I rub gently for around 4 minutes my sebaceous filaments get lifted off. Definitely repurchasing a full-sized one soon.
removes all the makeup, my skin doesn't feel dry afterwards. Also I noticed that my blackheads are starting to disappear

I was being skeptical about using oil cleanser but this one totally change my view and it can clean out the dirt ( like some blackhead and little oil particles ) from my skin after whole day of wearing sunscreen before my another step of cleansing , already used 3 bottles of it .

I usually use Tatcha's Camellia oil but it's expensive. I decided to switch to this one and I regret it. However I will use it up and will not repurchase. This does not emulsify at all: rinsing with water just leaves you like an oil slick.

I'm experienced with balm cleansers so I thought I would give a cleansing oil a shot. It's good when it works, but most of the time it doesn't emulsify and leaves a thick layer of oil on my face. Would not recommend, doesn't rinse off skin nicely.

avis.titre: I Found My New Favorite Cleanser
avis.texte: I was really happy to recieve this dear,klairs Gentle Black Fresh Cleansing Oil from WishTrend to Try & Review in the Beauty Tester program-I have been so curious about cleansing oils & really wanted to try dear klairs oil. I first was impressed with all the natural oils & Different black seed oils that also had antioxidants & minerals, that gently but so well clean, strengthen skin barrier ,prevent dehydration & the antiaging effects like cell regeneration. I wash my hands with warm water & dry.Now my warm clean hand warm the oil up ,massage it all over my face. While massaging we are also stimulating blood circulation that also aids collagen/cell regeneration. I let it set a couple minutes while it melts away makeup,impurities like dust & dirt in pores, primers can also clogged pores. Massage alittle warm (Not Hot) to start the emulsifaction it will turn milky like a milk cleanser and you can feel as you rub the oil break away from the skin. Rinse of- continue with the rest of my skincare regimen. My face feels so clean but without dry or stripped feeling alot of cleansers leave you feeling. I have dry/dehydrated/ aging skin I needed a cleanser that really cleans without adding to the aging process by drying out my skin more! Also my large pores in my T-zone amazingly look so much smaller which makes my makeup look better.Im so sold on this cleansing oil I will continue to use & my friends were wondering why my skin looks so bright & fresh lately so I believe they will be h

This product was terrible. My usual cleansing oil was out of stock so I decided to try this out. A good cleansing oil helps to melt makeup away as a first step of a nightly cleansing routine and this one is probably the worse one I've tried. It required too much work to remove makeup, was difficult to rinse off (even with the second step of washing with my favorite lathering cleanser), and it irritated my eyes every single time.

I always wanted to try this oil, it's very popular and very good I always use cleansing oils at my nightime routine and this one is one of the best I tried Does it removes makeup? Yes it removes ALL makeup, mascara, eyeshadows, lipstick, bb cream Does it emulsify? Yes and it's easy to rinse Does it irritate skin or eyes? No, no irritations at all and my eyes are very sensitive After use my skin feel soft, not oily, not tight It doesn't leave any residue (of course I use second cleanser) I love how easly it melts away my waterproof mascara It last for long, 3-4 pumps for face with full makeup
I personally believe in double cleansing..... this cleansing oil is my favorite I have purchased few, and will keep purchasing, recommend to people with sensitive, combination skin types. Must have!

I sometimes do an extra long cleanse up to 20mins or more for extra cleansing, short cleansers are just as good but this really helped with making my skin feel soft and removed blackheads/impurities especially those I have on and around my nose. it also helped with dry patches.

avis.titre: First Product Used From K-Beauty&I'm Not Disappointed!
avis.texte: Over the past 2 weeks I have been using this cleanser as my only cleanse; with Winter in Ontario Canada the elements are very stripping on my skin (baseboard heat&the weather are the biggest instigators). This cleanser, being an oil base, leaves my skin feeling hydrated&soft after every use; unlike my hydrating water base drugstore cleanser where it leaves it tight&dry which was a complete surprise. It easily removes any layered sunscreen&occasional makeup with very little to no effort; a good cleanse does help with anti-aging by removing things such as mascara which our skin does not need. The light fragrance, although not necessary, does make for a great experience&because it is a wash off treatment I have had no irritation or drying on my skin. It does not feel like I'm applying oil to my face&has a light texture when massaging over the skin; a very nice slip without any extra drag causing friction. With an oily T Zone (my nose mainly) I have noticed a significant decrease in the oil that my skin would normally produce; combating oil with oil! Overal, this cleanser has left my skin feeling more balanced&loved; more like it used to be when I was teenager. It has become one of my favorite products&one I reccomend. Looking forward to trying more from this Brand in future.
This oil cleanser is the best I've ever used!!! It really helps with the pores and makes my skin feel super clean!!

This product changed my perspective on cleansing oil. My oily skin is loving this cleansing oil, can you believe that? It makes my skin feeling clean, fresh and soft. It's a little bit on the pricey side but will definitely buy again.
Omggggg I'm so glad I found this and gave it a shot. It makes my skin so soft n buttery feeling!

A little bit hard to remove only with the water, you must absolutely use a second water cleanser after , but really nice effect after the double cleansing makes the skin feel really smooth !! I recommend

I have been slowly but surely, and with A LOT of research, incorporated K-beauty products into my routine ... and what a FANTASTIC idea it has been. I was hesitant to try this, being that it's an oil and I have combination skin, I veer of oil based products. But because this works as a cleanser rather than as a leave on mask, it's step #1 in my morning and night cleansing routine. Now, I only double cleanse at night, meaning that I use this product along another water based cleanser. Because of this, I have been able to see the effects of this product as a stand alone and they are lovely: leaves face hydrated soft and plump without clogging your pores. I also notice a different when I don't use it. I will say this, I have only started to double cleanse due to the cold so I haven't tried this during summer or much more humid temperatures. We will get to the bridge soon enough, as of now, it has become a STAPLE in my routine.

avis.titre: Oils are used for double cleansing
avis.texte: This product is meant to be used for double cleansing and not by itself
I love this oil cleanser. It's probably the first cleanser I've used consistently that doesn't sting my skin. It makes my skin feel so soft too.

Love this! I suffer with blackheads and after the initial 5 minutes of massaging they just start to rub out of my pores! It really is worth the buy- also great makeup remover! I discovered a few Klairs brands I love and this is a major one! Check out their PH balancing toner too!

LOVE this stuff!! I've read more about how makeup removing wipes aren't all that great for your skin as they can do damage over time and to try a double cleanse at night using an oil cleanser first to remove makeup. Found this gem and it works so well! It even removes waterproof mascara.
This cleanser removes all my sunscreen and doesn't leave a film on the face

I have sensitive skin and I love this product. I wear mineral sunscreen everyday and whenever I use this to cleanse my face, I don't feel any residue left. It does go by fast if you use 3 pumps every time but I try to use only 2 because it is pricey.

I use about 2 pumps and massage for a pretty long time before emulsifying - I find this method works best in helping to remove all the product from my face and not leave any greasy residue when rinsing. It works in terms of cleansing but definitely need to follow with a second cleanse to ensure everything has been removed off my face. I have not experienced any irritations or breakouts from this product. Purchased in April 2020.

I thought this oil cleanser would feel like other oil cleansers, and come off easy with water. However, it does not. It's not a problem for me, because I'm used to double cleansing anyway, but if you are someone who just likes to use one cleanser, then this is not for you. It leaves a coat of oil on your face, that you can literally feel. Also, with all the nice ingredients that it has in it, I thought it would have some kind of nice aroma to it. However, it does not smell like anything at all. Overall, it's an okay oil cleanser, but there are way better ones out there. Also, I received a free mini Klair's face mask jar with it. I'm actually enjoying the mask then the oil cleanser itself.😅

I use this oil cleanser as the first step in my double cleanse. I usually massage it into my face and nose for a while (up to 15 minutes) before I rinse it off. I find that when I massage it in for a long time, it does a really good job at reducing the sebaceous filaments on my nose, and reduces the look of the pores there significantly. I try to do a longer massage time twice a week, and do a shorter time the rest of the week. My only issue with this cleanser is a small one, but the oil doesn't emulsify as quickly or as completely as I would like. Sometimes its hard ot get all the oil residue off my face, so I have to do a lot of rinsing. It isn't really an issue though since I will go in with the second cleanser afterwards anyways. Overall this is a wonderful oil cleanser, with a wonderful ingredient list! shoutout to Robert Welsh on youtube for recommending it! I purchased this in May 2020
I finally incorporated double cleansing into my PM routine and this cleansing oil is as amazing as everyone says! Will definitely continue to buy!!
really great for taking off makeup, no irritation or breakouts. smells heavenly and hydrates.

I've been looking for an alternative to the Fresh Sugar Face Polish because I love it so much, but I can't justify spending $62 on a face scrub. This sounded pretty similar so I gave it a try, and I'm so glad I did! It smells and feels exactly like the one from Fresh, it's not too rough and it leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated. Thank you Klairs!!

Probably my favourite oil cleanser. It feels nice and surprisingly smells very good too. I cleanse with this sometimes for more than a minute to make sure the extra oil build up over the day is gone. My skin loves this one.

This is such a nice exfoliator! It's super gentle on my skin, and it leaves it looking cleaner and shinier than before. It's also a great lip scrub, so I use it every week for both my face and my lips!

I dont wear make up, just sunscreen and I can say that this product really removed all the products I used in my morning routine. After i used, i immediately felt my skin is soft and clean and ready for the evening routine. As if i dont need to use another cleanser, but as by the rule of beauty world, we need to double cleanse ( hahaha ). What im just saying that this product is very good at removing all the dirt and the remains of the products you used during the day. I will definitely purchase this again

I gave it 4 stars because whiles its good it just doesn't quite make me say "I love it!" I was looking for an cheaper alternative to Tatcha's Cleansing Oil. This one doesn't quite emulsify very well. And after rinsing twice, I feel the very soft slickness of oil on my face. I don't really like that and it's only gone after using my face wash. It does however remove my makeup very cleanly. I have oily skin so maybe that's why I'm sensitive to feeling more oil on my face.

I really like this oil cleanser. I had never tried the double cleansing routine but am I love with it now. The oil is super lightweight but really gets the dirt, makeup, and sunscreen off of the skin! and it doesn't leave my skin really oily which is good as I tend to break out from really oily products.

avis.titre: perfect first step of a double cleanse
avis.texte: This is for the first cleanse of a double cleanse. Take the time to massage in and you will feel little yuckies come out of your skin. Breaks down makeup, sunscreen. Follow up with your foam/cream cleanser. I have used and repurchased many times. My teen daughter now uses this when she wears a lot of makeup.

avis.titre: One pump works great, smells good!
avis.texte: I ordered this after seeing a great online review, and so far I'm liking it. One pump removes all my makeup, and I'm able to force my husband to use it because it has a nice unisex scent. The spout on the nozzle came broken, but it still works fine, so no big deal. Wish it was a little cheaper, but since I don't need to use much, it should go far.

It's great!! I feel like it helps more with white heads than blackheads. It was my first time using it and I really would recommend this. It leaves your skin feeling smooth and it doesn't clog pores. I would definitely buy this again.
My skin is very sensitive but these product is like magic; they don't irritate the skin and after this product my skin is already super clean.

avis.titre: I keep coming back to this
avis.texte: I tried multiple cleansing balms, oils & cleansers just to return to this!! As an extremely sensitive skin sufferer, some formulations are too hash with the exfoliating & pore cleansing ingredients. They usually burn my eyes, & make my skin angry & tight. So much so that I quit wearing make up since I couldn't tolerate the double cleansing ritual. I wish I had come full circle faster & had avoided all the frustration. I pair this with the foam cleanser in the pm.
I could see a difference after the first time I have problem with blackheads on my T zone but this helps a lot!.

I have always wanted to try KLAIRS as I'm allergic to perfume and parabens. I have extremely sensitive skin that can't handle a lot of different products. Using the oil cleanser as the first part of my cleansing routine has made sure that my face is completely clean by the time I put on products. It's a very soothing cleanser with a very faint smell. I absolutely love this product.

avis.titre: Great for sensitive skin and for effectively removing makeup
avis.texte: I've been looking for a cleansing oil and love this one! Of course, don't forget to follow up with a water-based cleanser after removing everything. Would definitely recommend to all skin types.

Excellent as usual. Klairs is an amazing brand. My skin is very sensitive and I always had problems trying to take care of it. But these products are like magic; they don't irritate the skin, they hydrate and nourish it. 100% recommended. And buying from Wishtrend is always a pleasure. Thank you !
I gave it a try and I don't like the residue it leaves behind. I have to wash it off several times with warm water just to make sure it's all out. Oil cleansers are probably not for me.

I was sceptical about using cleansing oils for a long time because of my somewhat oily acne prone skin, but I heard about the benefits of cleansing oils so I tried one from a different brand first and really hated it, as it left an annoying oily residue, even after a double cleanse. BUT I decided to give an oil another go and got this one because I generally enjoy klairs products. Thank goodness because I love this so muc and don't want to ever use anything but this one. It removes makeup well and I use it daily even if I am not wearing makeup because it removes sunscreen, dirt, and sweat from the day thoroughly. It has a very faint scent that I really like, but can't put my finger on what it is, but is nice and calming while massaging this into my skin. Upon emulsifying and rinsing off it doesn't leave my skin feeling heavy or oily at all, only soft and plump! I do always double cleanse after, but sometimes I don't even feel like I need to because my skin feels so nice after.
Breaks down the make-up, feels nice on the skin, easy to use because of smart packaging! Can recommend :)
Great product for removing makeup and sunscreen. I first found about it through a relative, and I've liked it ever since

I use this as part of my double cleanse routine to remove any makeup and spf. Works great to remove all the gunk without drying out my skin or being harsh on my skin! It's a staple of my nighttime routine.

It really lives up to its name! This cleansing oil is very gentle to my sensitive combination skin and a little bit goes a long way! I use 2-4 drops of it and it gets my mascara, eyeshadow, eyebrow pencil & gel, and my foundation off. What really helps this product work is using lukewarm water to rinse the oil. I like to massage the water on to my face for a bit and then rinse off. Sometimes I stop cleansing after that but if I did wear a full face of makeup that day, I will use a gentle foaming face cleanser to make sure my face is extra clean. Whether I double cleanse or not, my face is super soft and smooth! I definitely recommend to those who have sensitive skin and don't mind oil or to those who like to double cleanse! I will definitely buy this again in the future

This is now my go-to oil cleanser. I've been using cleansing balms forever and have now switched to Klairs exclusively. I like how it applies and how easy it is to remove before my next cleanse. I also prefer the pump vs. jar to dispense product. I will be repurchasing.

Pros: - Cruelty Free - Inexpensive - Non-irritating to the skin - Easy to apply Cons: - Doesn't remove makeup well (especially waterproof mascara) - Leave behind residue - Difficult to remove - Occasionally irritating to my eyes

I don't wear makeup but I use this in my night skincare routine and it cleans off the dirt during the day. My face doesn't feel dry after using it. It leaves my skin feeling soft and moisturized. I would purchase again if I can't find a better alternative for my acne-prone skin.

What i really love from this scrub is the scent and the sugar. I dont know what kind of this scent it has but it's definitely so calming scent. i love how gentle the sugar of this scrub is. Of course i feel the cleanest and softest face after i use this. It does remove my black- and whiteheads too. And i can organize the scrub how harsh or how soft i would have, just adding some drops of water. I experience a bit redness after use this but it doesnt stay long so i'm totally with that!
I always combine this cleanser with the gentle sugar scrub instead of adding water. It works for me the best way.
